title_zh: 刘德华：香港乐坛与影坛的「四大天王」之一
title_en: Chinese Pop Songs (12/20): Andy Lau, One of Hong Kong's "Four Heavenly Kings" of Music and Film
note_en: 随着 means "along with" or "as," linking a change to whatever accompanies it, and its clause comes first: 随着熟悉的音乐响起，观众都跟着他一起唱 "as the familiar music starts up, the audience all sing along." Unlike English "as," which can go mid-sentence, 随着 almost always opens the sentence, often followed by a verb phrase such as 音乐响起.
